teaser.en: Its bark is so smooth and powdery that, people say, even monkeys struggle to climb it.
teaser.sw: Gome lake ni laini na lenye unga-unga kiasi kwamba, watu husema, hata nyani hupata shida kuupanda.
teaser.dg: Gophare ni laini na rina unga-unga, hata nkugombwa kukala tumbiri piya anaona shida kuukpwera.

summary.en: *Mfune* is a tall, straight tree of coastal and riverine forest, reaching 40 metres, with smooth, powdery pale-yellow bark. It is surrounded by many myths and is often left standing when land is cleared for farms.
summary.sw: *Mfune* ni mti mrefu, ulionyooka wa misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito, unaofikia mita 40, wenye gome laini lenye unga-unga la rangi ya manjano iliyofifia. Umezungukwa na hadithi nyingi za kale na mara nyingi huachwa ukiwa umesimama ardhi inaposafishwa kwa ajili ya mashamba.
summary.dg: *Mfune* ni muhi mure na wa twaa wa matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, unaofika mita 40, wenye gopha laini, renye unga-unga, ra rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu. Kuna ngano nyinji kuhusu muhi uhu, na mara nyinji nkurichwa uchiima wakati atu anaphotema tsi kpwa kuhenda minda.

about.en:
*Mfune* is one of the tallest trees of the coast, growing up to 40 metres with a long, straight, clear trunk. Its bark is the thing to remember: smooth, powdery and pale yellow, almost glowing against the darker forest.

The leaves are large and lobed, clustered at the ends of the branches. The fruits are woody pods that split open to show the seeds, which in this family are often surrounded by irritating hairs.
about.sw:
*Mfune* ni mojawapo ya miti mirefu zaidi ya pwani, ukifikia hadi mita 40 na shina refu, lililonyooka lisilo na matawi. Gome lake ndilo la kukumbuka: laini, lenye unga-unga na la manjano iliyofifia, karibu kung'aa dhidi ya msitu wenye giza zaidi.

Majani yake ni makubwa na yenye mapindo, yamejikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi. Matunda yake ni maganda magumu kama mti yanayopasuka kuonyesha mbegu, ambazo katika familia hii mara nyingi huzungukwa na manyoya yanayowasha.
about.dg:
*Mfune* ni mwenga wa mihi mire zaidi ya pwani; unakula hadi mita 40, na kolo mure, ra twaa, ambaro tarina panda photsi. Chitu cha kutambukira ni gophare: ni laini, rina unga-unga, na ni ra rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, hata rinaonekana dza rinaala kahi ya tsaka ririro na jiza.

Makodzage ni makulu na gana mala, na ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda. Matundage ni makakaya mafu dza muhi ganagoahuka na kuonyesa tembe; kpwa jamii ihi, tembe mara nyinji zinazungulukpwa ni nyere zinazoawisa.

where.en: It grows in coastal and riverine forest, in coastal bushland and on coral rag. It is often left standing in farmland when the rest of the bush is cleared, so a lone, pale-trunked giant among the fields is very often a *mfune*.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito, katika vichaka vya pwani na juu ya miamba ya matumbawe. Mara nyingi huachwa ukiwa umesimama mashambani wakati vichaka vingine vinaposafishwa, hivyo jitu moja la shina jeupe katikati ya mashamba mara nyingi sana huwa ni *mfune*.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani na dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo. Mara nyinji nkurichwa uchiima mindani wakati vitsaka vyanjina vinaphotemwa, kpwa hivyo muhi mkulu sana uimao macheye kahi ya minda, wenye kolo ra rangi ngushu-ngushu, mara nyinji ni *mfune*.

uses.en: The Digo use its bark and leaves in medicine. Its seeds are eaten. The wood is soft and is used for carving and for walking sticks.
uses.sw: Wadigo hutumia gome na majani yake kama dawa. Mbegu zake huliwa. Mti wake ni laini na hutumika kwa uchongaji na kutengenezea bakora.
uses.dg: Adigo anahumira gophare na makodzage kpwa dawa. Tembeze nkuriwa. Nyama za muhi ni laini, na nkuhumirwa kutsonga vitu na kuhenda bakora.

culture.en: *Mfune* is associated with many myths. Its bark is said to be so smooth that even monkeys struggle to climb it.
culture.sw: *Mfune* unahusishwa na hadithi nyingi za kale. Inasemekana gome lake ni laini kiasi kwamba hata nyani hupata shida kuupanda.
culture.dg: Kuna ngano nyinji kuhusu *mfune*. Nkugombwa kukala gophare ni laini hata tumbiri piya anaona shida kuukpwera.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs record the Digo name *mfune*, which is shared with Swahili and Giriama. Swahili also has *msefu*. No common English name is in use; its scientific name is *Sterculia appendiculata*.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanarekodi jina la Kidigo *mfune*, ambalo pia linatumika kwa Kiswahili na Kigiriama. Kiswahili pia kina *msefu*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza linalotumika; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Sterculia appendiculata*.
names.dg: Pakia, na Maundu na Tengnäs, anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mfune*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ra Chigiryama. Chiswahili piya china dzina *msefu*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa ni atu; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sterculia appendiculata*.
